fdroid:com.roufsyed.onekey.name: 1Key Password Manager
fdroid:com.roufsyed.onekey.summary: Offline password manager. 2FA + notes. No account, no network, no telemetry.
fdroid:com.roufsyed.onekey.description:
1Key is a local-first password manager for Android. Your vault lives on your device, encrypted with a key only you hold, and never moves unless you export it yourself. There is no account to create, no server to breach, and no network connection of any kind — the INTERNET permission is stripped from the manifest, so the operating system itself enforces the offline guarantee.
 Security 
• Vault key derived from your master password with Argon2id (m=64 MiB, t=3, p=1 by default; configurable up to m=256 MiB, t=16)
• Every credential field encrypted separately with AES-256-GCM, bound to its row and column via additional authenticated data — an attacker with raw database write access cannot swap ciphertexts between rows
• Master-password verifier stored in EncryptedSharedPreferences, itself wrapped by an Android Keystore-bound key (TEE or StrongBox where available), so offline brute-force of a leaked device image is not possible
• Optional 128-bit Secret Key mixed into the KDF for defense-in-depth against a compromised master password
• Biometric unlock backed by hardware-secure key; requires master-password confirmation to enable
• Tiered attempt limiting: 3, 5, and 10 wrong attempts trigger 30-second, 5-minute, and 1-hour cooldowns; counters survive process kills
 Vault 
• Store credentials with title, username, password, URL, notes, and custom fields
• Tag-based organisation, favourites, full-text search
• TOTP / 2FA codes stored in the same entry as the password they protect — no app switching
• Live-preview Markdown in notes with a helper bar; disable in Settings if you prefer plain text
• Soft-delete recycle bin (toggle off if you prefer immediate deletion)
• Credential history preserves previous values on edit
 Autofill 
• System-level Autofill Service — fill logins into any app or browser without leaving them
• URL-only matching by default (no fuzzy suggestions) to keep phishing risk down
• Save prompt on submit; per-action confirmation for cross-host URL saves
 Backup and import 
• Encrypted backup as a .1key file (AES-256-GCM with Argon2id key derivation)
• Plain CSV / JSON export for interoperability
• Direct import from Google Passwords, LastPass, KeePass, 1Password, Dashlane, NordPass, Safari / iCloud Keychain — auto-detects format, no manual column mapping
 Unlock options 
• Master password (always available)
• 6-digit PIN
• Biometric (fingerprint / face)
• Background auto-lock: immediate / 30s / 1m / 5m
• Inactivity auto-lock: never / 30s / 1m / 5m / 15m
• Optional periodic master-password recheck (48h / 3d / 1w / 3w)
 What 1Key does NOT do 
• No accounts, no email, no signup
• No analytics, crash reporting, or telemetry
• No cloud sync (backup files go to a folder you choose — local, USB, Drive, Dropbox, NAS — never through us)
• No device identifiers, IP logging, or advertising IDs
• No network connection at all — INTERNET permission is stripped
 Anti-features 
The QR-scanning and OCR features use Google's ML Kit library, which contains proprietary code. All ML Kit processing happens on-device with the INTERNET permission stripped, so no data can leave the phone even if the library tried to phone home — but F-Droid still flags the dependency as NonFreeDep. If you want a fully libre build, you can build from source without ML Kit.
 Open source 
Source: https://github.com/roufsyed/1Key
Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later
Reproducible builds: yes
Built because paying $48/year to autofill a password should not be a thing.

fdroid:com.scariflabs.horus.name: Horus
fdroid:com.scariflabs.horus.summary: Run Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode in a real Linux terminal on your phone
fdroid:com.scariflabs.horus.description:
Your phone is an ARM64 Linux computer that spends most of its day running chat apps. Horus gives it a real job: it unpacks Alpine Linux inside the app and opens a terminal where Claude Code , Codex , and OpenCode can read your code, edit files, run the tests, and tell you what broke. You don't need root, Termux, or a computer.
 Ask an agent to fix a failing test while you're on the bus, then put the phone away. Sessions run in a foreground service, so they keep working with the screen off, and Horus sends a notification when an agent finishes or needs an answer from you.
 What you get 
 Coding agents in one tap. Pick an agent and Horus installs it the first time you open it, with the installer output right there in the terminal. You sign in inside each CLI; Horus never sees your provider credentials.
 A real Linux shell. Alpine comes from a pinned minirootfs whose SHA-256 digest is checked before anything is unpacked, and git, curl, ripgrep, Python, and Node are installed on demand. npm test, pytest, and a static ffmpeg build all run the way they would on a server.
 A terminal you can use with your thumbs. Swipe typing works, links open with a tap, and a key bar above the keyboard adds Esc, Tab, arrows, paste, and one-shot Ctrl and Alt.
 Your projects. Create a folder, clone any HTTPS or SSH Git URL, or sign in to GitHub and pick one of your repositories.
 Up to four sessions at once , say Claude Code in one project and Codex in another, each with its own notification.
 A file browser for checking what the agents changed, with text previews and a button that copies any folder to your Downloads.
 A lock. An optional password protects the app, and the workspace locks itself after 15 minutes in the background.
 Optional USB access from a computer. Pair the open-source horus command-line tool to get an SSH shell on the phone, copy files, forward ports, or run one command on several phones. It's off by default, listens only on the phone's loopback (reached through adb), and accepts only computers paired with your Horus password.
 Things to know 
 Horus needs an ARM64 (arm64-v8a) phone running Android 7.0 or newer.
 Alpine, its packages, and the agents download from their upstream servers when you first use them; mirrors are available in Settings for networks that can't reach those servers. Claude Code and Codex need accounts with their providers. Claude Code is proprietary, while Codex (Apache-2.0), OpenCode, and the shell are free software.
 Android's app sandbox is the only security boundary. PRoot emulates user IDs but gives no kernel isolation, so don't run code you don't trust.

Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. firefox-addons:3020047.description:

 Scroll depth and reading behavior
 Mouse movements and interaction patterns
 Time spent on each page
 Form activity and user engagement
 Device and browser fingerprinting techniques

 Tracking scripts
 Analytics platforms
 Advertising networks
 Fingerprinting technologies
 Third-party data collection services
After each scan, a simple privacy score helps you understand the site's behavior at a glance:
 🟢 Green — Minimal or no tracking detected
 🟡 Yellow — A moderate number of trackers found
 🔴 Red — Extensive tracking and data collection activity
Open the detailed report to view every detected service, including well-known platforms such as:
 Google Analytics
 Facebook Pixel
 DoubleClick
 Hotjar
 And many other tracking domains
Privacy Audit Dashboard is designed with privacy in mind:
 No data leaves your device
 All analysis runs locally in your browser
 No external API requests
 No accounts or sign-ups required
 No information is sent to third parties
Whenever a page changes, simply click Scan Now to perform a fresh analysis and receive an updated privacy score.
Understanding who collects your data is the first step toward protecting it. Privacy Audit Dashboard makes online tracking visible, transparent, and easy to understand.

1Password is a password manager that keeps you safe online. You want to use different passwords for every website, but it can be hard to keep track of them all. This personally identifiable information is never shared with third parties. It is only ever used to provide you with service and support. You can see our privacy policy for full details.
We believe strongly that your data is yours and we don’t want to know anything about it. This is one of the fundamental beliefs 1Password was built upon.

firefox-addons:837610.summary: Save images from open tabs. Default action saves largest image in active tab, with options to act on tabs to the left or right of the active tab.
firefox-addons:837610.description:
Tab Image Saver makes it easy to save images from multiple browser tabs.
 ⚠ Images can only be saved within the default downloads directory - this is a restriction of the Firefox WebExtensions API.
If this addon is not working as expected please report your issue on Github .
 Features: 
By default this addon saves the largest image found on the active tab.
You may control how this functions by changing the addon preferences at in Firefox > Add-ons > Extensions > Tab Image Saver > Preferences - Multitasking Support - run addon concurrently in separate windows
 - Right Click addon icon context menu for quick access to preferences
 - Keyboard shortcut option
 - Select from active tab, tabs to the left/right of current tab, or all tabs.
 - Cancel addon operation by clicking addon icon
 - Set minimum image size in pixels
 - Option to only save tabs with images, ignoring tabs with webpages
 - Filenames renamed automatically
 - Display badge on icon with showing progress and count of downloads
 - Close tabs after saving
 - Hide saved images from download history
 - Show notification when complete
 Permissions: - Access your data for all websites: 
 This is required to allow the addon to work on any website. The addon does not inspect websites until you choose to save images from tabs. 
 - Download files and read and modify the browser's download history: 
 This addon downloads images and can optionally remove completed downloads from your history. It will only remove downloads from history that were created from this addon and does not read your download history. 
 - Display notifications to you: 
 A notification will display when the addon finishes processing and downloading. This notification can be disabled in the addon options. 
 - Access browser tabs: 
 This addon only accesses tabs when you select the addon to begin and only processes tabs attached to the selected window.

apple-macos:1492318174.name: Video Doctor • Repair MP4, MOV
apple-macos:1492318174.description:
With Video Doctor, you can repair corrupted, damaged, or unplayable media files right on your iPhone. It can also repair files that still play but have playback errors, dropped frames, visual artifacts, or compatibility problems with some players. Supported video formats include MP4, MOV, M4V, 3GP, AVI, and MKV. MP3 audio files are also supported.
Your files can be corrupted for various reasons, such as incomplete copying or downloading, an accidental shutdown, a broken camera, a dead battery, a software crash, or faulty hardware.
Video Doctor can repair such files in most cases.
FEATURES
• Repairs unplayable files in MP4, MOV, M4V, 3GP, AVI, MKV, and MP3 formats
• Fixes errors in supported media files
• Simple app, just a few taps
• Repair your files fast, easy preview, no complicated options
NOTE
Not all videos can be repaired, and this applies to any media recovery software out there; it depends on the kind of damage they have.
With the free version of the app, if the repair process is successful, you can preview the video, but you cannot export the file.
The application contains one in-app purchase option (one-time payment, never expires). After the purchase, Video Doctor will be able to export any number of repaired video files.
Support
We read your support emails every day.
Feel free to send us any question, feedback, or complaint, and you will receive an answer very quickly.

apple-macos:6758154644.name: NutCase: Nut Tracker & Health
apple-macos:6758154644.description:
NutCase is your companion for a simple daily habit: a handful of nuts. Log it in one tap, see your week at a glance, and learn what each nut actually brings, including when to stop.
ONE TAP A DAY
The dashboard opens with the only question that matters: have you had your nuts today? A check mark answers it, seven slots show your week, and your usual nuts sit right there as one-tap buttons. Missed days simply stay empty: no red marks, no guilt.
WIDGET AND CONTROL CENTER
Put the Today's Handful widget on your Home Screen or Lock Screen and log your usual nut without opening the app. Tapped the wrong one? Undo appears on the widget for 15 minutes. Prefer Control Center? Add "Log My Usual Handful" there, to the Lock Screen or to the Action button. On Mac, the same widget sits on your desktop or in Notification Center. Reminder notifications have a "Log it" button, too.
INSIGHTS: YOUR HABIT OVER TIME
See your month as a calendar of handful days. Follow magnesium, vitamin E, selenium, fiber and protein week by week. See how varied your nut mix is and which nut would add something new. Pick goals such as heart or brain health and see which nuts list benefits for them. The last 4 weeks are free; Premium opens 12 weeks, a whole year and every past month.
YOUR NUT LIBRARY
Explore 13 nuts: almonds, walnuts, cashews, Brazil nuts, pistachios, pecans, hazelnuts, macadamias, peanuts, cedar nuts, chestnuts, baru nuts and black walnuts. Each profile includes:
• Nutrition facts per serving and key nutrients as % of daily value
• Benefits, risks and recommended daily intake
• Honest limits: a single Brazil nut covers a day's selenium, so NutCase recommends at most one a day
• Allergy tracking: set a severity per nut (none, mild, moderate, severe, anaphylactic) and get a warning before you log it
The Eating Guide covers amounts, mixing, timing, and contaminants and sensitivities, with sources.
This information is for educational purposes only and is not medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider before making dietary changes.
REMINDERS THAT FIT YOUR DAY
Set a reminder for a nut, a time and a portion (count, weight or a simple handful), daily or on chosen days. Each reminder shows your current and longest streak. The free version includes one reminder; Premium unlocks unlimited reminders.
DASHBOARD AND HISTORY
See calories, protein, fiber and variety from the nuts you've logged, and tap any card for details. Edit or delete entries any time; a deleted entry can be brought back with Undo. With Premium, export your full history as CSV.
ON YOUR MAC AND YOUR WRIST
NutCase is a real Mac app, with sections as toolbar tabs, an Intake menu with keyboard shortcuts, and a table for every day. On Apple Watch, log a handful from your wrist.
FREE TO START, PREMIUM WHEN YOU'RE READY
NutCase is free forever for iOS, iPadOS and macOS: log your intake, use the widget and Control Center, explore all 13 nut profiles, follow the eating guide, track allergies, see Insights for the last 4 weeks, choose light or dark appearance, and keep one active reminder.
Unlock NutCase Premium with a 14-day free trial, free via the App Store, no credit card required. After the trial, choose what suits you:
• Yearly subscription: renews annually, cancel any time
• Lifetime purchase: pay once, all future Premium features included forever
Premium unlocks:
• Insights over 12 weeks, a whole year and every past month
• Unlimited reminders
• CSV export of your intake history
YOUR DATA, YOUR CONTROL
Your data stays on your devices and, if you use iCloud, syncs across them. iCloud sync is free for everyone, and we never see your data. Delete any of it from Settings → Data Management. No ads, no tracking, no data sold.
A COMPANION, NOT A COMMANDMENT
NutCase doesn't lecture or guilt-trip. It's a calm tool for eating nuts more often and more mindfully, so the habit actually lasts.
